notes.emptyBody: Select a face in the 3D view and choose Add note. Notes are context for the assistant.
notes.placeholder: For example: round this edge with R2 instead of R1
notes.contextHint: The note stays on this face after rebuilds; if the face changes, the note is marked.

viewer.errorTitle: The model could not be read
viewer.errorBody: The mirrored file is damaged or has an unknown format ({message}).
viewer.disconnectedBody: Showing the last mirrored revision. Start SolidCraft to continue editing.
viewer.hint: Click a face to select it

checks.levelsExplained: L created · TG technically checked · SC executed in SolidCraft. SL and PD need a slicer check and a print record.
checks.levelsReset: Parameters changed. Verification is back to L until the checks pass on the new revision.
checks.open: {count, plural, one {# open edge} other {# open edges}}
checks.overhangDetail: Downward faces steeper than {limit}° from vertical; the bed layer is excluded. The limit is the check default, an assumption until a printer profile provides a measured value.
checks.sourceComputed: Computed from the mirrored mesh in the prototype
checks.sourceMock: Mock result; the product runs the timeline check after each step
checks.noModel: Checks need the mirrored model. Reload it or open the design in SolidCraft again.

print.title: Print package
print.noProfileBody: A print package needs a printer, nozzle and material profile. Calibration values are used only with a complete validity key.
print.gateExplained: The print gate releases a package only when every overhang finding has a solution with proof. A released gate is not a print confirmation (PD).

chat.toolCalls: {count, plural, one {# tool call} other {# tool calls}}

tool.inspect: Read timeline and parameters of revision 14

card.question: How wide should the snap opening be for the 10 mm cable?

option.opening75: Same ratio as today (9 mm for 12 mm). The snap force stays similar. Assumption until a test fit confirms it.
option.opening80: Easier to insert; holds the cable less firmly.
option.opening70: Holds firmer; the clip arms bend further when the cable is pressed in.

card.whyAsked: Asked because the opening sets the snap force and no measured value exists.
card.otherInvalid: Enter a value from {min} up to, but not including, {max}.

change.title: Proposed change
change.note: Applying rebuilds the model in SolidCraft. Checks run again afterwards; verification falls back to L until they pass.

notice.unreachableBody: Start the local server or choose another model in the model menu.
notice.contextTitle: Context too small: {context} tokens (agent sessions need {minimum})
notice.contextBody: Increase the context length in {vendor} (num_ctx) or choose another model.
notice.noToolsBody: It can answer questions but cannot change the design or run checks.
notice.solidcraftBody: The assistant can answer questions but cannot change the design until SolidCraft runs.
notice.missingKeyBody: Add a key in the provider settings. Keys are stored in the Windows Credential Manager, never in files.
notice.rateLimitBody: The assistant retries automatically. You can also switch to another model.

mock.request: Make the clip hold a 10 mm cable. The mounting holes stay where they are.
mock.analysis: The channel diameter follows cable_d_nominal + channel_compensation. channel_compensation is 0 mm because no calibration value exists yet; that is an assumption. A 10 mm channel rebuilds without errors. One question before I change the snap opening:
mock.proposal: The base plate and the mounting holes stay unchanged.
mock.appliedSystem: Prototype: the change is simulated; the 3D model does not change.
mock.prototypeReply: Prototype: no model is connected, so this message gets no reply.
